shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,280p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml
rg -n \"specs/.*#|validated by|spec:\" src/orchestration --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80
cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "specs/[''^ ]+#[0-9]+|@spec|spec anchor|validated by:" src scripts specs --glob '"'*.ts' --glob '*.md' | head -160
ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true
rg -n \"require-spec-link|VALIDATED_BY|spec anchor\" eslint.config.* scripts . | head -120"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md
git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Fix registry test mock inspection" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
